description.value:
Thick smoke billows from a point within range, filling a 20-foot-radius sphere that curls around corners and heavily obscures its area for the duration, or until a wind of at least 10 miles per hour disperses it.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, the radius increases by 20 feet for each slot level beyond 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
